title: Misty's Bubble Bath: the fixes you asked for
kaylee: Misty now slides down the muddy bank on her bottom and goes KER-SPLOSH into a big water splash, in a mossy green rainforest, with real-looking berries and hockey sticks.
questions: Does the forest feel like the Great Bear Rainforest now?

pictures.title: The rainforest
pictures.caption: Moss up the bark, moss beards, sword ferns, moss mounds, fallen mossy logs, trunks into a green haze

pictures.title: The splash
pictures.caption: A crown of water, a jet, flying drops and rings, not a white column

pictures.title: The hockey stick (everywhere in Canada)
pictures.caption: The blade joins the shaft at the heel, curved, with tape and a knob

pictures.title: The berries
pictures.caption: Raspberries, blueberries with their little crowns, blackberries
